title: DeepTalk VitalSpan Agent Tools
description: DeepTalk VitalSpan Agent Tools. Product: vitalspan plugin components.tools (Node). CI/dev scripts: docs/api/vs-ai-spec/tools/*.py

tools.name: vitalspan_health_check
tools.description: GET /health before workflow 2 or 3

tools.name: vitalspan_get_contract_card
tools.description: Workflow 2: return contract_card.json (L0 rules on demand)

tools.name: vitalspan_get_capability_catalog
tools.description: Machine-readable capabilities for experts (chartTypes, paradigms, layout constraints, optional themes)

tools.name: vitalspan_scaffold_artifact
tools.description: Workflow 2: scaffold customViz under examples/ (default generic-blank-*)

tools.name: vitalspan_validate_artifact
tools.description: Workflow 2: preflight + structured fix/snippet JSON + validate stamp

tools.name: vitalspan_publish_artifact
tools.description: Validate + POST/PUT customViz bundle to platform library. Completion requires ok artifactId= and styleComplianceTier=full in stdout.

artifact_id.description: Optional existing uuid for PUT update

tools.name: vitalspan_list_artifacts
tools.description: List current user's ai_viz artifacts

q.description: Filter by manifest id or displayName

tools.name: vitalspan_delete_artifact
tools.description: DELETE artifact by id (owner only); default 409 if referenced; pass unlink=true to remove widgets from dashboards first

unlink.description: When true, DELETE ?unlink=true removes referencing widgets then deletes artifact

tools.name: vitalspan_get_artifact
tools.description: Download full bundle to workspace examples/ for edit→validate→publish PUT

tools.name: vitalspan_list_artifact_dashboard_refs
tools.description: List dashboards/data-screens referencing artifactId

tools.name: vitalspan_delete_dashboard
tools.description: DELETE dashboard or data-screen by uuid

tools.name: vitalspan_validate_chart_config
tools.description: Workflow 1: validate L1/L2 chartConfig via POST /charts/validate

tools.name: vitalspan_validate_layout_draft
tools.description: Workflow 3: validate layout JSON + record upload stamp (5min)

tools.name: vitalspan_patch_dashboard_layout
tools.description: Workflow 3: patch layout file (merge or operations JSON)

tools.name: vitalspan_apply_screen_theme
tools.description: Workflow 3 optional: merge screen theme into styleConfig

tools.name: vitalspan_route_request
tools.description: Optional wf1/wf2/wf3 suggestion from capability-routing.json

tools.name: vitalspan_list_layout_references
tools.description: Workflow 3: read-only index of layout reference ids (REFERENCE ONLY)

tools.name: vitalspan_get_layout_reference
tools.description: Workflow 3: export read-only layout reference JSON under workspace

tools.name: vitalspan_list_layout_rhythms
tools.description: Workflow 3 default: list Layout Rhythm Contracts (LRC) — generic layout grammar

tools.name: vitalspan_list_chart_types
tools.description: Workflow 1/3: list built-in chartType ids

tools.name: vitalspan_compose_dashboard
tools.description: Workflow 3 optional scaffold: rhythm + blocks (topology only). Delivery via upload file.

rhythm.description: Layout rhythm id from list_layout_rhythms (wf3 default)

blocks.description: JSON array of {band, kind, chartType?, artifactId?, title?}

template.description: Legacy preset layout id from list_layout_templates

tools.name: vitalspan_get_dashboard_layout
tools.description: Workflow 3: GET dashboard + write editor-save JSON for style-only patch

tools.name: vitalspan_create_dashboard
tools.description: Create empty dashboard or data-screen (prefer compose_dashboard for workflow 3)

tools.name: vitalspan_list_dashboards
tools.description: List dashboards and data-screens

tools.name: vitalspan_upload_dashboard
tools.description: Workflow 3: PUT dashboard editor-save layout from file or inline chart_types

tools.name: vitalspan_completion_gate
tools.description: Reject completion without artifactId+tier=full (wf2) or compose/upload stdout with layout widgets (wf3)

tool_stdout.description: Required for workflow 2 (publish) and 3 (compose/upload) raw tool output
